$comment: Design-system PROJECT REGISTRY. One entry per Figma-backed design system this repo drives. Read by libs/altitude-mcp/src/lib/ds-project.mjs, which resolves the active project from --project <id>, the DS_PROJECT env var, or `default` below. Everything that used to be a hardcoded 'Altitude' string in the parity tooling (Figma file key, manifest path, prompt pipeline, Storybook identity) now comes from here.

decoys.why: Empty scratch file; an earlier pass built 31 component sets into it by mistake. Refuse to write here.

excluded.al-theme-switcher: Owns no pixels — an al-button + al-popover + al-menu composition; a Figma set would duplicate three components (altitude-figma-sync: NOT_COMPONENTS).
excluded.al-icon: Icons live in Figma as 71 flat components on the 🛠 Icons page (resolved by name), not as a component set — there is nothing for a per-set parity check to bind to.

library.$componentsComment: SCOPE. Southleft's design system is the subset of al-web-components that southleft.com actually ships, not the whole 105-component Altitude catalog. Derived from `grep -rhoE '<al-[a-z0-9-]+' apps/southleft/src --include=*.astro` and re-checkable with scripts/check-sl-scope.mjs. Adding a component to the SITE is what earns it a place here; keep the two in step or the DS documents things Southleft does not use and the parity list fills with noise.

excluded.al-theme-switcher: Owns no pixels — an al-button + al-popover + al-menu composition; a Figma set would duplicate three components.
excluded.al-icon: Icons are a 1,512-glyph Phosphor catalog resolved by name, not a component set — nothing for a per-set parity check to bind to.
excluded.al-theme: The theming HOST — sets brand/mode/density tokens on :host and owns no pixels of its own. Nothing for Figma to mirror.
